0022600121.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-2, 11th in the East, 4th in the Central and 2 games back) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, 8th in the East, 3rd in the Atlantic and 1 game back) for the Bulls' fourth game of the season, with Chicago on a one-game losing streak and Boston on a one-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Bulls lost 1-2 to the Celtics in 2025-26, including a 124-105 loss in Boston on February 11, 2026. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, Noa Essengue and Patrick Williams are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions (head bruise and groin soreness, respectively), and Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness.
